card.text: Explore Haumea’s measured elongated shape and narrow ring, with an illustrative NASA surface texture.

introduction.text: Haumea is a rapidly rotating, elongated dwarf planet with a narrow ring. Its surface is shown using NASA’s illustrative model texture; no spacecraft has mapped it.

illustration.title: Surface illustration
illustration.summary: The depicted terrain is imagined, not photographed. The real surface is unresolved, and the displayed coordinates are arbitrary.
